description: Charged: $0.02 flat per call by default, no token multiplier. Ask a question of a collection and get a generated answer with citations. Maps to POST /v1/collections/{collectionId}/query. Query a collection once `get_status` says completed. With an API key it needs the key's `query` scope. Without an API key this tool is payable in USDC via x402: the first call returns a payment-required result (`isError` with the payment requirements in `structuredContent`); an x402-aware MCP client signs and retries the same call with `_meta['x402/payment']`, and the receipt returns in the result's `_meta['x402/payment-response']`. Never pay again after a 409 (already presented) or 502 (settlement unknown) result. Keyless, only the address that paid for the collection may query it. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.
name: query_collection
title: Query a collection
